mdRunbook.secrets.inject.markdownDescription: Names of stored secrets (**md-runbook: Set Secret**) passed to every cell as environment variables of the same name. Their values are always redacted.

mdRunbook.execution.envFile.markdownDescription: A `.env` file whose `KEY=VALUE` lines are passed to every cell as environment variables, e.g. `.env` or `${workspaceFolder}/.env`. Relative paths are relative to the runbook's folder. A missing file is ignored.

mdRunbook.redaction.redactKnownSecrets.markdownDescription: Redact the values loaded from `mdRunbook.execution.envFile` (exact match) from live and saved output. Stored secrets and secret inputs are always redacted.

mdRunbook.params.useDefaults.markdownDescription: Use a runbook parameter's front-matter default without asking. Parameters without a default are still asked for.
